question: Which notebooks did I change in the last week, and when?
Who has modified notebooks in the last 7 days, and how many times each?
Show notebook activity by action type over the last week
Which users deleted or renamed notebooks recently?

content: Audit trail over analytical code (DS-08). system.access.audit records every workspace action. Filter service_name='notebook' for notebook events; action_name values include modifyNotebook, createNotebook, deleteNotebook, renameNotebook, openNotebook, runCommand. The actor is user_identity.email. ALWAYS filter on event_date (a partition column) to bound the scan, e.g. event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS. request_params holds the notebook path or id. Answer with grouped summaries: who did what, how many times, and when it last happened.
